Exam point: teeke ke virodh ke peechhe 'Shakti' yaani urja roop me God ka vishwas tatha devi 'Jagdamba' ke krodh ka bhay tha; samanya halat me vaccination ka virodh nahi hota tha tatha 1921-22 me 62,981 teeke safal hue.

qe: Besides the Patna General Hospital, which three hospitals of the district were state institutions, the rest being supported from Local Funds?
qh: पटना जनरल अस्पताल के अतिरिक्त जिले के कौन-से तीन अस्पताल राजकीय संस्थान थे, जबकि शेष स्थानीय निधि से चलते थे?
oe: Those at Patna City, Barh and Bihar
Those at Gulzarbagh, Gardanibagh and Bikram
Those at Khagaul, Fatuha and Bakhtiarpur
Those at Maner, Punpun and Mokameh
oh: पटना सिटी, बाढ़ तथा बिहार के अस्पताल
गुलज़ारबाग, गरदनीबाग तथा बिक्रम के अस्पताल
खगौल, फतुहा तथा बख्तियारपुर के अस्पताल
मनेर, पुनपुन तथा मोकामा के अस्पताल
e: Jile ki chikitsa-vyavastha do tarah ki thi - sarkari (state) sansthayein tatha Local Funds yaani sthaniya nidhi se chalne wale aspatal aur dawakhanne. Rajkiya sansthanon me Patna General Hospital tatha Gulzarbagh, Gardanibagh aur Bikram ke aspatal shamil the. Sthaniya nidhi se chalne wale aspatal Patna City, Barh, Bihar tatha Dinapore me the, jabki Maner, Punpun, Khusrupur, Karai-Parsarai, Mokameh, Rajgir, Bharatpura, Khagaul, Masaurhi, Chandi, Islampur, Fatuha, Bakhtiarpur, Harnaut tatha Paliganj me dawakhanne the. 1922 me Patna General Hospital par kharch Rs 1,24,200 hua tatha anya sarkari aspatalon par Rs 18,740. Exam point: Patna General Hospital ke alawa Gulzarbagh, Gardanibagh tatha Bikram ke aspatal rajkiya sansthayein thi, jabki Patna City, Barh, Bihar aur Dinapore ke aspatal sthaniya nidhi se chalte the.

qe: The number of patients treated in the hospitals and dispensaries of the district rose from 119,000 in 1895 and 160,000 in 1905 to how many by 1922?
qh: जिले के अस्पतालों तथा दवाखानों में इलाज कराने वालों की संख्या 1895 में 119,000 तथा 1905 में 160,000 से बढ़कर 1922 तक कितनी हो गई?
e: Jile ke aspatalon tatha dawakhanon me ilaj karane walon ki sankhya varsh-dar-varsh badhti gayi - 1895 me 119,000, 1905 me 160,000 tatha 1922 me 257,000. Isse pata chalta hai ki yuropiy yaani angrezi chikitsa-paddhati logon me lokpriya hoti gayi. 1922 me Patna General Hospital me hi 10,636 surgical operations yaani shalya-chikitsa ke operation hue; anya sarkari aspatalon me 1,466, sthaniya nidhi ke aspatalon me 13,226 tatha dawakhanon me 5,657 operations hue. Is avadhi me rogon ke aankde bhi rakhe jaate the, jinme enteric fever, kala-azar, malaria, dysentery tatha aankhon tatha kaan ke rog pramukh the. Exam point: ilaj karane walon ki sankhya 1895 ke 119,000 se badh kar 1922 me 257,000 ho gayi, jo angrezi chikitsa-paddhati ki badhti lokpriyta darshata hai; 1922 me Patna General Hospital me 10,636 operations hue.

qe: How many surgical operations were performed at the Patna General Hospital during the year 1922?
qh: वर्ष 1922 में पटना जनरल अस्पताल में कितने शल्य-चिकित्सा के ऑपरेशन किए गए?
e: 1922 me Patna General Hospital me 10,636 surgical operations yaani shalya-chikitsa ke operation kiye gaye, jo jile ke kisi bhi sansthan me sabse adhik the. Usi varsh anya sarkari aspatalon me 1,466, sthaniya nidhi se chalne wale aspatalon me 13,226 tatha dawakhanon me 5,657 operations hue. Operations ki sankhya se yah pata chalta hai ki bade aspatal par shalya-chikitsa ka bhair kitna tha tatha chhoti sansthaon me zyadatar rogi davai tatha salah ke liye aate the. Sthaniya nidhi ke aspatalon tatha dawakhanon me krishi-karya se jude logon ko nazdiki ilaj uplabdh karana unka mukhya uddeshya tha. Exam point: 1922 me Patna General Hospital me 10,636 operations hue, jabki anya sarkari aspatalon me 1,466, sthaniya nidhi ke aspatalon me 13,226 aur dawakhanon me 5,657 operations hue.

qe: Expenditure on the Patna General Hospital during the year 1922 was how much?
qh: वर्ष 1922 के दौरान पटना जनरल अस्पताल पर कितना व्यय हुआ?
e: 1922 me Patna General Hospital par Rs 1,24,200 kharch hua; anya sarkari aspatalon par Rs 18,740 tatha sthaniya nidhi se chalne wale aspatalon tatha dawakhanon par Rs 1,01,700 kharch hua. Isse pata chalta hai ki jile ki chikitsa-vyavastha me sabse badi rashi bade sarkari aspatal par kharch hoti thi, jabki sthaniya nidhi ke aspatalon tatha dawakhanon ko mila kar lagbhag utna hi dhan diya jaata tha. Chikitsa tatha safai jaise kaamon ke kharch ki tulna karne se yah bhi samajh aata hai ki jile ke sadhan seemit the tatha unka badlav dheere-dheere hota tha. Exam point: 1922 me Patna General Hospital par Rs 1,24,200, anya sarkari aspatalon par Rs 18,740 tatha sthaniya nidhi ke aspatalon-dawakhanon par Rs 1,01,700 kharch hua.

qe: In the year 1919-20 the expenditure of the District Board on sanitation was how much?
qh: वर्ष 1919-20 में जिला बोर्ड का स्वच्छता पर कितना व्यय था?
e: 1919-20 me District Board yaani jila parishad ka swachhta par kharch Rs 18,527 tha. Jile ke gaon me swachhta-sudhar ke kaam mushkil the, kyunki log vyaktigat safai ka to dhyaan rakhte the, lekin apne aas-paas ki gandi paristhiti ke prati udaasin the; gaon ka sthal ganda, pashuon se bhara tatha nali-paani se rahit hota tha. Iske bawajood Local Boards ne kai swachhta-sudhar ke kaam kiye - jaruriyat se zyada gaddhe bhar diye gaye, ghan ugane wali jhaadiyan saaf ki gayin tatha gandagi hatayi gayi; is kaam me ve poore prant ke liye aadarsh maane jaate the. Exam point: 1919-20 me District Board ka swachhta-kharch Rs 18,527 tha; Local Boards ne gaddhe bharna, jhaadiyan saaf karna tatha gandagi hatana jaise kaam karke poore prant ke liye udaharan sthapit kiya.

qe: The Municipal Act, under which great improvements in water-supply, drainage, street cleaning and sewage were effected in the towns, was introduced in which year?
qh: नगरों में जल-आपूर्ति, नाली-निकासी, गली-सफाई तथा मल-निष्कासन में बड़े सुधार जिस नगरपालिका अधिनियम के तहत हुए, वह किस वर्ष लागू किया गया?
e: Nagaron me swachhta ka kaam gaon se zyada mushkil tha, kyunki ghar mukhya sadkon tatha tang galion me ek doosre se sate hue the; behtar shreni ke ghar bina hawa-aane-jaane ki vyavastha ke banaye jaate the, jabki zyadatar ghar mitti ke, halke unche chabutare par bane tatha logon se bhare hote the. 1884 me Municipal Act lagu hone ke baad nagarpalikaon ko paani ki aapurti, drainage, gali ki safai tatha sewage yaani mal-nishkasan jaise vishayon par kaam karne ki shakti mili. Iske baad kai sudhar hue, lekin samay kam tatha nagarpalikaon ke paas dhan ki kami thi, isliye saikdon varsh ki udaasini se paida hui gandagi poori tarah door nahi ho saki. Exam point: 1884 me Municipal Act lagu hua, jisse nagarpalikaon ko paani, drainage, gali-safai tatha sewage ke vishayon par kaam karne ki shakti mili; iske baad kaafi sudhar hue, lekin dhan ki kami ke kaaran sab samasyayein door nahi hui.

qe: Under the sanitary operations of the Local Boards, sweepers were employed in the larger villages under the control of whom?
qh: स्थानीय बोर्डों के स्वच्छता-कार्यों के अंतर्गत बड़े गाँवों में भंगियों/सफ़ाईकर्मियों को किसके नियंत्रण में लगाया गया?
oe: A village headman or respectable resident
oh: गाँव का मुखिया या किसी सम्मानित निवासी
e: Bade gaonon me swachhta banaye rakhne ke liye Local Boards ne safai-karmiyon ki niyukti ki tatha unke kaam ka prabhar gaon ke mukhiya ya kisi sammanit nivasi par daala. Gaon me kaam ye the - jaruriyat se zyada gaddhe bharna, tez ugane wali jhadiyan saaf karna tatha gandagi hatana. Is tarah ki vyavastha se gaon ke logon ki sahbhagita bhi badhi, kyunki safai ka prabhar bahar ke karmachari ke sthan par gaon ke hi prabhavshali vyakti ke paas tha. Isi tarah gaon ke chaukidar janm-mrityu ki suchna police tak pahunchate the, jo jile ke svasthya aankdon ka adhar banti thi. Exam point: bade gaonon me safai-karmiyon ka prabhar gaon ke mukhiya ya kisi sammanit nivasi ke paas tha tatha unka kaam gaddhe bharna, jhadiyan saaf karna tatha gandagi hatana tha.

qe: In the villages of the district, why was the water of the tanks a danger to health?
qh: जिले के गाँवों में तालाबों का पानी स्वास्थ्य के लिए खतरा क्यों था?
oe: They were used only for watering cattle
They were too deep ever to be cleaned
Drains were apt to find their way into them and they were used indiscriminately for cooking and bathing
They were always dry in the hot weather
oh: उनका उपयोग केवल पशुओं को पानी पिलाने में होता था
वे इतने गहरे थे कि साफ़ कभी नहीं हो सकते थे
उनमें नालियाँ आ कर मिल जाती थीं तथा वे खाना बनाने और नहाने दोनों के लिए बिना भेदभाव प्रयोग होती थीं
गर्मी में वे हमेशा सूखे रहते थे
e: Gaon ke log apni vyaktigat safai ka to poora dhyaan rakhte the, lekin apne aas-paas ki gandi paristhiti ke prati udaasin the tatha lok-swachhta ki bhawna unme kam thi. Gaon ka sthal ganda, pashuon se bhara tatha nali-paani ki vyavastha se rahit hota tha; ghar andhere tatha bina hawa ke hote the, jinhe aas-paas ke gaddhe se nikali mitti se banaya jaata tha, jisse wahi gaddha thehra hua ganda kunda ban jaata tha. Kuon ki theek tarah suraksha nahi hoti thi tatha ghar ka maila paani unki or aa jaata tha; isi prakar talabon me naliyan mil jaati thi tatha unhi ka paani khana banane aur nahane ke liye bina kisi bhed ke use hota tha. Exam point: talabon me naliyon ka paani mil jaata tha tatha unhi ka paani khana banane aur nahane dono kaam aata tha; isi karan paani se phailne wale rog - cholera tatha dysentery - gaon me aam the.

qe: In 1812 there were no public schools in the district, and the school-house built for the guru outside the village, lest he should see the women too frequently, was called what?
qh: 1812 में जिले में कोई सार्वजनिक पाठशाला नहीं थी, तथा गुरु के लिए गाँव के बाहर बनाए जाने वाले पाठशाला-गृह को क्या कहा जाता था, जिससे वह स्त्रियों को अधिक बार न देखे?
e: Unnisvin shatabdi ke aarambh me jile me shiksha ka bhar niji vyavastha par tha. 1812 me yahan koi sarkari ya sarvajanik pathshala nahi thi tatha koi aisa guru ya adhyapak nahi tha, jo kisi dhanwan vyakti ka naukar na ho. Gurus ko aam taur par padosiyon ke bachchon ko padhane ki anumati hoti thi tatha unke liye gaon ke bahar ek pathshala-grih banaya jaata tha, jise pinda kaha jaata tha; yah naam kai pavitra maane jaane wali cheezon ke liye bhi use hota tha. Gaon ke bahar pathshala banane ka karan yah tha ki guru ko baar-baar streeyon ke aane-jaane ki jagah dekhne ka mauka na mile. Jahan ganne ki kheti hoti thi, wahan pandaane wala ghar yaani boiling-house hi aam taur par pathshala ka kaam karta tha. Exam point: 1812 me jile me koi sarvajanik pathshala nahi thi; guru ke liye gaon ke bahar bane pathshala-grih ko pinda kaha jaata tha tatha ganne wale kshetron me boiling-house hi pathshala ka kaam karta tha.

qe: As described in 1812, which language was used in the courts, many Hindus being taught to read and write its character before they began Hindi?
qh: 1812 के वर्णन के अनुसार न्यायालयों में कौन-सी भाषा प्रयोग होती थी, जिसकी लिपि पढ़ना-लिखना बहुत से हिंदुओं को हिंदी से पहले सिखाया जाता था?
e: 1812 me nyayalayaon tatha sarkari kaam-kaj me Persian yaani Farsi bhasha ka prayog hota tha; isi karan bahut se Hindu bachchon ko Hindi se pehle Farsi lipi padhna-likhna sikhaya jaata tha. Lekin adhiktar log isse aage nahi badh paate the - ve keval itna seekh paate the ki rajasv ka hisab samajh sakein tatha likh sakein, aur ek patra theek se samajhna ya likhna unke liye kathin hota tha. Jo vyakti rajasv ka hisab samajh kar likh leta tha, use munshi kaha jaata tha. Is tarah shiksha ka uddeshya mukhyatah sarkari kaam-kaj ke liye karmachari taiyar karna tha, na ki vyakti ka samagra vikas. Exam point: 1812 me nyayalayaon me Farsi bhasha ka prayog hota tha tatha bahut se Hindu Hindi se pehle Farsi lipi seekhte the; rajasv-hisab likh-samajh lene wale vyakti ko munshi kaha jaata tha.

qe: A man whose education went no further than learning to understand and write a revenue account was entitled to be called what in the district as described in 1812?
qh: 1812 के वर्णन के अनुसार जिले में वह व्यक्ति क्या कहलाने का हक़दार होता था, जिसकी शिक्षा केवल राजस्व-हिसाब समझने तथा लिखने तक ही रह जाती थी?
e: 1812 me jile me shiksha ki halat yah thi ki adhiktar log Farsi padh kar bhi rajasv ka hisab samajh tatha likh lene ke aage nahi badhte the; kisi ko theek se patra likhna ya samajhna nahi aata tha. Isi karan zameendar bhi mukhyatah kisani the tatha unme se aadhe log padhna nahi jaante the; harek parivar ka mukhiya keval itna seekh leta tha ki woh apne naam jaisa koi nishan bana sake. Jo vyakti rajasv ka hisab samajh kar likh leta tha, use munshi kaha jaata tha. Is tarah shiksha ka star bahut seemit tha tatha likhe-padhe karmachariyon ki sankhya bhi kam thi, jiska anuman lagbhag bees hazaar yaani aabadi ka ek point do pratishat tha. Exam point: rajasv ka hisab samajh-likh lene wale vyakti ko munshi kaha jaata tha; adhiktar log isse aage nahi padhte the tatha likhe-padhe karmachari aabadi ka lagbhag ek point do pratishat hi the.

qe: How many pandits were teaching the higher sciences of the Hindus, such as grammar, law and metaphysics, and about how many moulvis instructed a few young men in Persian literature and Arabic science in 1812?
qh: 1812 में व्याकरण, विधि तथा तत्व-दर्शन जैसी हिंदुओं की उच्च विद्याएँ कितने पंडित पढ़ाते थे, तथा लगभग कितने मौलवी कुछ युवकों को फ़ारसी साहित्य तथा अरबी विज्ञान सिखाते थे?
oe: About fifty pandits and a dozen moulvis
About twenty pandits and two moulvis
About thirty-eight pandits and half a dozen moulvis
About half a dozen pandits and thirty-eight moulvis
oh: लगभग पचास पंडित तथा एक दर्जन मौलवी
लगभग बीस पंडित तथा दो मौलवी
लगभग अड़तीस पंडित तथा छह मौलवी
लगभग छह पंडित तथा अड़तीस मौलवी
e: 1812 me jile me uchch shiksha ke keval do chhote kendra the. Persian sahitya tatha Arabic vigyan me kuch yuvaon ko lagbhag aadhe darjan yaani chhah moulvi padhate the, jabki Hindunon ki uchch vidyayein - vyakaran, vidhi yaani law tatha tatva-darshan yaani metaphysics - padhane wale pandit lagbhag adtees yaani thirty-eight the. Yani uchch shiksha me shikshak tatha vidyarthi dono ki sankhya bahut kam thi tatha yah vyavastha kuch badon ke parivaron tak hi seemit thi. Sarkari sthar par shiksha ke liye koi vyavastha nahi thi; 1815 me Court of Directors ka mashhoor educational despatcha aaya, jisme kaha gaya ki sarkar ko India me aam shiksha ke vistar tatha vyavasthik vikas me sahayta deni chahiye. Exam point: 1812 me uchch vidya padhane wale lagbhag adtees pandit the tatha Farsi-Arabic sikhanewale lagbhag chhah moulvi; uchch shiksha ka vistar bahut seemit tha tatha 1815 ke educational despatch ke baad sarkar ne vidyalaya kholne shuru kiye.

qe: The total number of persons fit to act as writers in the district was estimated in 1812 at nearly what figure, being about 1.2 per cent of the population?
qh: 1812 में जिले में लेखक का काम करने योग्य व्यक्तियों की कुल संख्या लगभग कितनी अनुमानित की गई थी, जो आबादी का करीब 1.2 प्रतिशत थी?
e: 1812 me jile ki shiksha-vyavastha niji haath me thi tatha sarkari vidyalaya nahi the. Isi karan jo log likhne-padhne ke kaam ke liye taiyar the, unki sankhya bhi bahut kam thi - anuman lagaya gaya ki aise vyakti lagbhag bees hazaar the, jo jile ki aabadi ka karib ek point do pratishat hi the. Adhiktar zameendar kisani the tatha aadhe log to padhna bhi nahi jaante the; house-hold ka mukhiya keval apne naam jaisa nishan bana lena seekh leta tha. Iske vipareet kar rajasv ka hisab samajhne-likhne wale munshi tatha Persian padhe karmachari seemit sankhya me the, isliye sarkari kaam-kaj ke liye taiyar karmachariyon ki kami rahi. Exam point: 1812 me lekhak ke kaam ke liye yogya logon ki sankhya lagbhag bees hazaar yaani aabadi ka karib ek point do pratishat thi; padhe-likhe karmachariyon ki kami hi sarkari shiksha-vistar ka mukhya karan bani.

qe: In 1815 the famous educational despatch, laying down that Government should afford assistance to the more extended and systematic promotion of general education in India, was issued by which authority?
qh: 1815 में वह प्रसिद्ध शिक्षा-आदेश (educational despatch) किस प्राधिकारी ने जारी किया, जिसमें कहा गया कि सरकार को भारत में सामान्य शिक्षा के अधिक व्यापक तथा व्यवस्थित विस्तार में सहायता देनी चाहिए?
oe: The Secretary of State for India
e: Unnisvin shatabdi ke pehle aadhe hisse me sarkar ne shiksha ka kaam niji prayas par chhod rakha tha; jile me keval maktab tatha pinda jaise pathshala the, jo Farsi tatha Hindi padhate the. 1815 me Court of Directors ka mashhoor educational despatcha jaari hua, jisme kaha gaya ki sarkar ko India me aam shiksha ke adhik vyapak tatha vyavasthit vistar me sahayta deni chahiye tatha iske liye sarkar dwara niyantrit, sahayata-prapt tatha kuch bhaag me pratyaksh roop se chalayi jaane wali ek poori yojna banayi gayi. Isi nirdesh ke mutabik sarkar ne vidyalaya kholne shuru kiye; 1860-61 me sarkar dwara chalaye jaane wale nau vernacular yaani deshi-bhasha ke vidyalaya the, jinme 399 vidyarthi padhte the. Exam point: 1815 ka educational despatcha Court of Directors ne jaari kiya, jisme sarkar ko India me aam shiksha ke vyapak tatha vyavasthit vistar me sahayta dene ka nirdesh tha; isi ke baad sarkari vidyalaya khulne lage.

qe: The Patna College was opened in which year, at a time when the number of vernacular schools maintained by Government was nine with 399 pupils?
qh: पटना कॉलेज किस वर्ष खोला गया, जब सरकार द्वारा चलाए जाने वाले देशी-भाषा के विद्यालयों की संख्या नौ तथा उनमें पढ़ने वाले विद्यार्थियों की संख्या 399 थी?
e: 1815 ke educational despatch ke baad sarkar ne jile me vidyalaya kholne shuru kiye. 1860-61 me sarkar dwara chalaye jaane wale nau vernacular schools the, jinme kul 399 vidyarthi padhte the; 1862 me Patna College khola gaya, jo jile ki uchch shiksha ka sabse mahatvapurna kendra bana. 1870-71 tak Patna College ke alawa 23 sarkari tatha sahayata-prapt vidyalaya the, jinme 1,530 vidyarthi padhte the. Aage chalkar 1880-81 me aided tatha unaided uchch vidyalaya, middle vernacular, lower vernacular tatha primary schoolon ka poora jaal ban gaya tatha yah sankhya nirantar badhti rahi. Exam point: Patna College 1862 me khola gaya; us samay sarkar dwara chalaye jaane wale nau vernacular schools me 399 vidyarthi aur 1870-71 me Patna College ke alawa 23 sarkari-sahayata-prapt vidyalayaon me 1,530 vidyarthi padhte the.

qe: The Temple Medical School, established in 1874, had how many pupils, as against the 101 pupils of the Patna normal school in 1880-81?
qh: 1874 में स्थापित टेंपल मेडिकल स्कूल में कितने विद्यार्थी थे, जबकि 1880-81 में पटना नॉर्मल स्कूल में 101 विद्यार्थी थे?
e: Patna College ke alawa unnisvin shatabdi ke ant me anya vishesh sansthayein bhi kaam kar rahi thi. Temple Medical School, jise 1874 me sthapit kiya gaya, usme 146 vidyarthi padhte the; Government survey school me 29 vidyarthi tatha Patna normal school me 101 vidyarthi the, jahan shikshak taiyar kiye jaate the. 1880-81 me Patna College ke saath ek law school bhi tha, jisme 41 vidyarthi kanoon ki padhai karte the. Is tarah unnisvin shatabdi ke ant tak chikitsa, survey, teacher-training tatha kanoon jaise vyavsayik vishayon ki shiksha ke liye alag-alag sansthayein ban chuki thi, jo aage ke sansthagat vikas ka aadhar bani. Exam point: 1874 me sthapit Temple Medical School me 146 vidyarthi the tatha 1880-81 me Patna normal school me 101, Government survey school me 29 tatha Patna College se jude law school me 41 vidyarthi the.

qe: In 1880-81 the district had 1,633 primary schools; how many pupils were under instruction in them?
qh: 1880-81 में जिले में 1,633 प्राथमिक विद्यालय थे; उनमें कितने विद्यार्थी पढ़ रहे थे?
e: 1880-81 me jile me shiksha ka jaal vyapak ho gaya tha. Us saal 1,633 primary yaani prathmik vidyalaya the, jinme 93,154 vidyarthi padhte the; yah sankhya unnisvin shatabdi ke ant tak badhkar ek hazaar sarkari-ya-sahayata-prapt tatha 612 niji sansthaon tatha 36,477 vidyarthiyon tak pahunch gayi. Isi avadhi me 46 lower vernacular vidyalaya 2,095 vidyarthiyon ke saath tatha 16 middle vernacular vidyalaya 927 vidyarthiyon ke saath kaam kar rahe the. Is prakar prathmik shiksha hi sabse bada kshetra thi, jabki madhyamik tatha uchch shiksha me vidyarthiyon ki sankhya tulnatmak roop se kam thi. Exam point: 1880-81 me 1,633 prathmik vidyalayaon me 93,154 vidyarthi padhte the, jabki 46 lower vernacular me 2,095 tatha 16 middle vernacular me 927 vidyarthi the; dasak ke ant tak kul 1,985 sansthaon me 36,477 vidyarthi ho gaye.

qe: By 1921-22 the grand total of all educational institutions in the district was how many, with how many pupils on the rolls?
qh: 1921-22 तक जिले की सभी शिक्षण संस्थाओं का कुल योग कितना था तथा कुल कितने विद्यार्थी पढ़ रहे थे?
e: 1874 me Temple Medical School sthapit hone ke baad shiksha ka vistar tezi se badha. 1900-01 me jile me 1,626 vidyalaya the, jinme 38,162 vidyarthi padhte the; 1910-11 me sarkari tatha sahayata-prapt sansthaon ki sankhya 1,439 tatha vidyarthi 40,288 ho gaye tatha niji sansthaon me 4,831 vidyarthi ho gaye. 1921-22 tak jile ki saari sansthaon ka kul yog 1,791 ho gaya, jinme 51,489 vidyarthi padhte the - inme 1,587 sarkari-sahayata-prapt sansthaon me 47,467 tatha 204 niji sansthaon me 4,022 vidyarthi the. Yah vriddhi dikhati hai ki 1815 ke educational despatcha tatha 1884 ke baad ki shiksha-niti ka asar dheere-dheere poore jile me phaila. Exam point: 1921-22 tak jile me kul 1,791 shiksha-sansthayein tatha 51,489 vidyarthi the, jabki 1900-01 me 1,626 sansthaon me 38,162 vidyarthi the; yah vriddhi sarkari shiksha-niti ke vistar ka parinam thi.

qe: In 1921-22 there were 238 public institutions for females in the district; how many pupils had they, against 2,422 pupils in 165 such institutions in 1910-11?
e: 1921-22 me jile me stri-shiksha ke kshetra me bhi vriddhi hui thi. 1910-11 me striyon ke liye sarvajanik sansthaon ki sankhya 165 thi, jinme 2,422 vidyarthi padhti thi; 1921-22 tak yah sankhya badhkar 238 sansthaon tatha 4,536 vidyarthiyon ki ho gayi. In sansthaon me high schools tatha middle english schools bhi shamil the, jahan uchch shiksha di jaati thi; niche ke star par lower primary schools ki sankhya 145 se badhkar 226 ho gayi tatha unme padhne wali vidyarthiyon ki sankhya 1,950 se 3,063 ho gayi. Isi samay purushon ki niji sansthaon ki sankhya 397 se ghat kar 199 ho gayi, yaani sarkari-sansthayein bade paimane par badhi. Exam point: 1921-22 me striyon ke liye 238 sarvajanik sansthaayein tatha 4,536 vidyarthi thi, jabki 1910-11 me 165 sansthaon me 2,422 vidyarthi thi; lower primary me vidyarthi 1,950 se badh kar 3,063 ho gayi.

qe: A committee appointed in 1913 under the chairmanship of Sir Robert Nathan drew up the scheme for which institution, planned as a teaching and residential university to be located immediately to the west of the New Capital?
qh: 1913 में सर रॉबर्ट नाथन की अध्यक्षता में नियुक्त समिति ने किस संस्था की योजना तैयार की थी, जिसे नई राजधानी के ठीक पश्चिम में एक शिक्षण तथा आवासीय विश्वविद्यालय के रूप में बसाना प्रस्तावित था?
e: Bihar me uchch shiksha ke liye ek vishwavidyalaya ki maang lambi samay se thi. 1913 me Sir Robert Nathan ki adhyakshta me niyukt ek samiti ne yojana tayar ki, jisme prastav tha ki Patna me ek shikshan tatha aavasiya yaani teaching aur residential university banayi jaye, jo New Capital ke theek pashchim me sthit ho. Yah vishwavidyalaya praant ke anya collageon par bhi wahi niyantran rakhti, jo pehle Calcutta University rakhti thi. Vishwavidyalaya ki sthapna 1 October 1917 ko hui, lekin vittiya yaani paise ke karanon se kendriya vishwavidyalaya ki yojana poori nahi ho saki; iske paas apna koi bhavan nahi tha, keval Bankipore me ek daftar tha tatha adhyayan ka kaam iske ang colleges hi karte the. Exam point: 1913 me Sir Robert Nathan samiti ne Patna me teaching aur residential university ki yojana banayi tatha yah vishwavidyalaya 1 October 1917 ko sthapit hui; kendriya vishwavidyalaya ki yojana paise ke karanon se poori nahi hui tatha adhyayan ka kaam ang colleges karte the.

qe: At the examinations of 1920, how many candidates were registered at the matriculation stage, as against 1,059 at the intermediate and 502 at the degree stage?
qh: 1920 की परीक्षाओं में मैट्रिकुलेशन स्तर पर कितने परीक्षार्थी पंजीकृत थे, जबकि इंटरमीडिएट स्तर पर 1,059 तथा डिग्री स्तर पर 502 थे?
e: Nayi vishwavidyalaya ki sthapna ke baad uske star par pareeksha dene walon ki sankhya tezi se badhi. 1920 me vibhinn staron par panjikrit yaani registered hone wale pareeksharthiyon ki sankhya is prakar thi - matriculation star par 4,298, intermediate star par 1,059, degree star par 502 tatha higher degree star par keval 29. Usi varsh education me 34 tatha law me 390 candidate pareeksha me baithne wale the. Yah aankde dikhate hain ki sabse adhik bhid matriculation jaise nichle star par thi tatha uchch degree star par vidyarthiyon ki sankhya bahut kam thi; vishwavidyalaya ke adhyayan ka kaam iske ang colleges hi kar rahe the. Exam point: 1920 me matriculation star par 4,298, intermediate par 1,059, degree par 502 tatha higher degree par 29 candidate panjikrit the; education me 34 tatha law me 390 candidate the tatha uchch star par vidyarthi bahut kam the.

qe: Which is the oldest European school in the district, opened at Bankipore in 1853 as a Roman Catholic boarding and day school for girls, managed by the nuns of the Institute of the Blessed Virgin Mary?
qh: जिले का सबसे पुराना यूरोपीय विद्यालय कौन-सा है, जो 1853 में बांकीपुर में बालिकाओं के लिए रोमन कैथोलिक बोर्डिंग तथा डे स्कूल के रूप में खोला गया और जिसे इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ द ब्लेस्ड वर्जिन मैरी की ननें चलाती थीं?
e: Unnisvin shatabdi ke madhya me Patna me yuropiy shiksha ki shuruat hui. Jile ka sabse purana yuropiy vidyalaya St. Joseph's School hai, jo Bankipore me 1853 me khula tatha balikaon ke liye ek Roman Catholic boarding tatha day school tha; ise Institute of the Blessed Virgin Mary ki nun yaani isai sanyasiniyan chalati thin. Is vidyalaya me 171 boarders yaani aavasiya vidyarthi tatha 21 day scholars yaani din me aane-jaane wale vidyarthi the, jinme se aadhe ladke bhi shamil the. Bankipore me hi balikaon ka ek uchch vidyalaya bhi tha; yani jile me balikaon ki shiksha ke liye isai sansthaon ne pehle-pahal shuruat ki thi tatha yah vidyalaya dekh-rekh tatha padhai dono ki suvidha deta tha. Exam point: jile ka sabse purana yuropiy vidyalaya St. Joseph's School, Bankipore hai, jo 1853 me balikaon ke boarding-day school ke roop me khula tatha jisme 171 aavasiya aur 21 din ke vidyarthi the.

qe: St. Michael's High School at Kurji owed its existence to which Vicar Apostolic of Patna, who in 1854 purchased the grounds in which it stands with the object of forming a community of Indian Christians?
qh: कुर्जी का सेंट माइकल हाई स्कूल किस पटना विकर अपोस्टोलिक के कारण अस्तित्व में आया, जिसने 1854 में वह भूमि खरीदी थी जहाँ यह स्थित है, ताकि भारतीय ईसाइयों का एक समुदाय बनाया जा सके?
e: St. Michael's High School Kurji me sthit hai, jo Bankipore tatha Dinapore ke beech padta hai. Iski shuruat Monsignor Zuber ke prayas se hui, jo us samay Patna ke Vicar Apostolic yaani pradhan dharmadhikari the; unhonne 1854 me yah bhoomi kharidi, jahan Indian Christians ka samuday banane ki yojana thi. Lekin 1857 ke vidroh ne yah yojana bigaad di - naye isai shishya bikhra gaye tatha sthal vidyarthiyon se khali ho gaya. Shanti lauttne par Dr. Hartmann, jo tab Patna ke Vicar Apostolic the, ne us bhavan me un bachchon ke liye anathalay khola, jo vidroh me anath ho gaye the; yahi anathalay aage chalkar ek bade boarding house tatha anathalay ke roop me badha. 1894 me yah sanstha Irish Christian Brothers ko saunpi gayi, jinke prabandh me yah safal vidyalaya bani; school me 194 ladke the, jinme bahut se anath the. Exam point: Kurji ke St. Michael's High School ki bhoomi 1854 me Vicar Apostolic Monsignor Zuber ne kharidi thi; vidroh ke baad Dr. Hartmann ne wahan anathalay khola tatha 1894 me yah Irish Christian Brothers ko saunpi gayi, jahan 194 ladke padhte the.

qe: The Bihar National College was founded in 1883 as a high school by which pleader practising at Patna, before being raised to the status of a second-grade college in 1889?
qh: बिहार नेशनल कॉलेज 1883 में पटना में वकालत करने वाले किस प्लीडर द्वारा एक हाई स्कूल के रूप में स्थापित किया गया था, इससे पहले कि 1889 में इसे सेकंड-ग्रेड कॉलेज का दर्जा मिले?
e: Patna me niji prayas se kai vidyalaya khule, jinme Bihar National College pramukh tha. Iski sthapna 1883 me Babu Biseswar Singh naam ke ek pleader yaani vakil ne ek high school ke roop me ki; 1889 me yah second-grade college bana tatha 1892 me ise B.A. star tak utha liya gaya. 1907 me ise pehli baar sarkari sahayata mili tatha 1922 tak yah har mahine Rs 2,950 ki grant pa raha tha. Yah arts tatha science me degree star tak shiksha deta tha; isme 23 shikshak tatha 31 March 1922 ko 390 vidyarthi the; 1921-22 me iska pratyaksh kharch Rs 67,157 tha tatha karib assi aavasiya vidyarthiyon ke liye hostel ki vyavastha thi. Exam point: Bihar National College 1883 me pleader Babu Biseswar Singh ne high school ke roop me khola, 1889 me second-grade college bana, 1892 me B.A. star tak pahuncha tatha 1907 se sarkari sahayata paane laga; 1922 me isme 390 vidyarthi the.

qe: New College at Patna was formed in 1911 by transferring the intermediate classes in Arts back from Patna College to which institution, the very school from which they had developed nearly sixty years before?
qh: पटना का न्यू कॉलेज 1911 में आर्ट्स की इंटरमीडिएट कक्षाओं को पटना कॉलेज से उसी संस्था में वापस भेजकर बनाया गया, जिस विद्यालय से वे लगभग साठ वर्ष पूर्व विकसित हुई थीं?
e: 1911 me ek nayi vyavastha ki gayi - Patna College se Arts ki intermediate kakshayein wapas Patna Collegiate School me bhej di gayin, jisse yah school aage New College ke roop me vikasit hua. Jagah banane ke liye Collegiate School ki chaar nichli kakshayein band kar di gayin. Is naye college ke college-kakshaon me 178 vidyarthi the tatha 1921-22 me in kakshaon par pratyaksh kharch Rs 39,080 hua. Intermediate kakshaon ko school ki uchch kakshaon ke saath jodne wali yah vyavastha Calcutta University Commission ki ek mahatvapurna sifarish se milti-julti thi; staff me 22 shikshak the, jinse aasha thi ki woh school tatha college dono ki kakshaon ko padha sakenge. Exam point: New College 1911 me Patna Collegiate School me Arts ki intermediate kakshayein wapas bhejkar banaya gaya; uski college-kakshaon me 178 vidyarthi the tatha 1921-22 me kharch Rs 39,080 hua, jabki staff me 22 shikshak the.

qe: The Nalanda College at Bihar was established in July 1920 on lines similar to those of New College; it owed its existence to an endowment made by which Rai Bahadur, yielding an income of Rs 8,000 a year?
qh: बिहार में नालंदा कॉलेज जुलाई 1920 में न्यू कॉलेज की तर्ज़ पर स्थापित हुआ; इसका अस्तित्व किस राय बहादुर द्वारा दिए गए दान से संभव हुआ, जिससे सालाना 8,000 रुपये की आय होती थी?
e: Nalanda College, Bihar me July 1920 me New College ki tarz par sthapit hua tatha yah ek endowment yaani daan par chalta tha, jo late Rai Bahadur Edal Singh ne diya tha. Is daan se saalana Rs 8,000 ki aay hoti thi, jo college kakshaon ka kharch lagbhag poora kar deti thi; pichhle saal in kakshaon ka kharch Rs 8,972 tha tatha roll par 31 vidyarthi the. Is tarah unnisvin shatabdi ke aakhir tatha beesvin shatabdi ke aarambh me Patna tatha Bihar me kai naye college khule - New College, Nalanda College, Training College tatha Law College - tatha uchch shiksha ka vistar hua. Exam point: Nalanda College Bihar me July 1920 me khula tatha Rai Bahadur Edal Singh ke endowment se ise saalana Rs 8,000 ki aay hoti thi; us samay roll par 31 vidyarthi the tatha kakshaon ka kharch Rs 8,972 tha.

qe: The Patna Training College was opened in 1908 to train twelve students for the diploma of Licentiate in Teaching; from which year did it train candidates for the degree of Bachelor of Education?
qh: पटना ट्रेनिंग कॉलेज 1908 में लाइसेंशिएट इन टीचिंग डिप्लोमा के लिए बारह विद्यार्थियों को प्रशिक्षित करने के लिए खोला गया; किस वर्ष से इसने बैचलर ऑफ एजुकेशन डिग्री के लिए प्रशिक्षण देना शुरू किया?
e: Shikshak taiyar karne ke liye Patna Training College 1908 me khula, jahan shuru me barah vidyarthiyon ko Licentiate in Teaching yaani L.T. diploma ke liye prashikshan diya jaata tha; 1915 se yah Bachelor of Education yaani B.Ed. degree ke liye bhi prashikshan dene laga tatha saalana pravesh badhakar chalees kar diye gaye. B.Ed. tatha L.T. dono kakshaon ka course ek session ka hota tha tatha harek kaksha me bees vidyarthi liye jaate the. 1921 tak yah college mukhyatah unhi logon ke liye tha, jinhe naukri mil chuki thi, khaaskar sarkari naukri; 1921 ke baad aadhe sthan naukri chahne wale candidateon ke liye aarakshit yaani reserved ho gaye. Naukri-prapt vidyarthiyon ko prashikshan ke dauran poora vetan milta tha tatha anya vidyarthiyon ko graduate hone par Rs 35 ya intermediate pass hone par Rs 25 ka subsistence allowance milta tha. Exam point: Patna Training College 1908 me khula tatha 1915 se B.Ed. degree ke liye prashikshan dene laga, jahan saalana pravesh chalees tak badhaya gaya; naukri-prapt vidyarthiyon ko poora vetan tatha anya vidyarthiyon ko Rs 35 ya Rs 25 ka allowance milta tha.

qe: The Patna Law College, which developed out of the law classes at Patna College, was housed in a residential building recently acquired at which locality?
qh: पटना लॉ कॉलेज, जो पटना कॉलेज की लॉ कक्षाओं से विकसित हुआ, हाल ही में अधिग्रहित एक आवासीय भवन में किस मोहल्ले में रखा गया था?
e: Patna College ki law kakshaon se hi aage Patna Law College ka vikas hua. Yah Chauhatta ke ek aavasiya bhavan me rakha gaya. Yahan vidyarthiyon ko Bachelor of Law yaani B.L. degree tatha pleadership certificate ke liye taiyar kiya jaata tha; dono course teen saal ke the, lekin B.L. me keval graduate hi pravesh pa sakte the. B.L. kakshaon me 272 vidyarthi tatha pleadership ki kakshaon me 18 vidyarthi the. B.L. kakshaon ke liye ek pura-samay ke principal tatha chhah part-time lecturers the, jabki pleadership ke liye ek part-time lecturer. Is tarah unnisvin shatabdi ke ant tak kanoon ki vyavsayik shiksha ke liye alag sanstha ban chuki thi. Exam point: Patna Law College Chauhatta ke ek aavasiya bhavan me tha, jahan B.L. tatha pleadership ke teen-saal ke course chalte the; B.L. me 272 tatha pleadership me 18 vidyarthi the tatha B.L. me keval graduate hi pravesh pa sakte the.

qe: In 1901 the district had 109,618 literate persons, forming 6.8 per cent of the population; what was the number of literate persons in 1921?
qh: 1901 में जिले में 1,09,618 साक्षर व्यक्ति थे, जो आबादी का 6.8 प्रतिशत थे; 1921 में साक्षर व्यक्तियों की संख्या कितनी थी?
e: Shiksha ke vistar ke saath saaksharata bhi badhi. 1901 me jile me saakshar yaani padh-likh sakne wale vyaktiyon ki sankhya 1,09,618 thi, jo aabadi ka 6.8 pratishat tha tatha inme 7,981 log English padh-likh sakte the. 1921 tak yah sankhya badhkar 1,37,088 ho gayi, jo aabadi ka 8.7 pratishat tha tatha inme 16,267 log English padh-likh sakte the. Khaas baat yah thi ki Patna ko praant ke kisi bhi anya jile ki tulna me adhik saaksharata ka dar hasil tha tatha mahilaon me yah badhat aur bhi spasht thi. Yani 1901 se 1921 ke beech saakshar logon ki sankhya karib sattais hazaar badhi tatha English jaanne walon ki sankhya dugni se bhi adhik ho gayi. Exam point: 1901 me jile me 1,09,618 saakshar vyakti (6.8 pratishat, jinme 7,981 English jaante the) the; 1921 me yah sankhya 1,37,088 (8.7 pratishat, 16,267 English jaante the) ho gayi tatha Patna praant me saaksharata me sabse aage tha.

qe: In 1880-81 there was only one school for girls in the district with 65 pupils and only 28 girls attending boys' schools; by 1890-91 how many schools for girls were there, with an attendance of 1,257 girls?
qh: 1880-81 में जिले में बालिकाओं के लिए केवल एक विद्यालय था जिसमें 65 विद्यार्थी थीं तथा केवल 28 लड़कियाँ लड़कों के विद्यालयों में पढ़ती थीं; 1890-91 तक बालिका विद्यालयों की संख्या कितनी हो गई थी, जिनमें 1,257 लड़कियाँ पढ़ती थीं?
e: Patna me balikaon ki shiksha ka vikas tulnatmak roop se naya tha. 1880-81 me jile me balikaon ke liye keval ek vidyalaya tha, jisme 65 vidyarthi thin, tatha keval 28 ladkiyan ladkon ke vidyalayaon me padhti thin. 1890-91 tak balika vidyalayaon ki sankhya badhkar assi ho gayi tatha unme 1,257 ladkiyan padhne lagin; iske atirikt 317 ladkiyan ladkon ke vidyalayaon me padh rahi thin, is tarah kul 1,574 ladkiyan padh rahi thin. 1901 me 65 balika vidyalaya the jinme 939 vidyarthi thin tatha 178 ladkiyan ladkon ke vidyalayaon me thin. 1910-11 me balika vidyalayaon me 2,448 tatha ladkon ke vidyalayaon me 787 ladkiyan thin; 1920-21 me yah sankhya 4,591 tatha 62 ho gayi. Exam point: 1880-81 me balikaon ka keval ek vidyalaya tha; 1890-91 tak assi vidyalaya ho gaye jinme 1,257 ladkiyan padhti thin tatha 317 ladkiyan ladkon ke vidyalayaon me thin, is tarah kul 1,574 ladkiyan padh rahi thin.

qe: The high school for girls at Bankipore, formerly an aided school and taken under Government management in 1914, was founded in 1867 by which community?
qh: बांकीपुर का बालिका हाई स्कूल, जो पहले सहायता-प्राप्त विद्यालय था तथा 1914 में सरकारी प्रबंधन में ले लिया गया, 1867 में किस समुदाय द्वारा स्थापित किया गया था?
e: Bankipore ka balika uchch vidyalaya jile ka ekmatra balika high school tha, jiski sthapna 1867 me Bangali samuday ne ki thi; pehle yah sahayata-prapt yaani aided vidyalaya tha tatha 1914 me ise sarkari prabandhan me le liya gaya. Us samay isme 111 vidyarthi thin tatha yah Gola ke paas sthit Bari Nepali Kothi naam ke bhavan me chal raha tha; iske paas hi sthit Chhoti Nepali Kothi ko halke hi me vidyalaya ko hostel ke liye de diya gaya tha. Iske atirikt balikaon ke liye do middle English vidyalaya the - ek Bankipore me Baptist Mission dwara chalaya jaata tha tatha doosra sarkar dwara Badshah Nawab Razvi Training College ke practising school ke roop me. Exam point: Bankipore ka balika high school 1867 me Bangali samuday ne sthapit kiya tha, jise 1914 me sarkari prabandhan me liya gaya; us samay isme 111 vidyarthi thin tatha yah Bari Nepali Kothi bhavan me chalta tha, jabki do middle English balika vidyalaya the.

qe: A training college for women was established in Patna in January 1909 with the help of an endowment by Saiyid Badshah Nawab Razvi of Patna City; it was housed in a building near which locality, formerly belonging to the Bettiah estate?
qh: पटना में जनवरी 1909 में महिलाओं के लिए एक प्रशिक्षण कॉलेज की स्थापना पटना सिटी के सैयद बादशाह नवाब रज़वी के दान से हुई; यह किस इलाक़े के पास स्थित उस भवन में रखा गया, जो पहले बेतिया राज्य का था?
e: Mahilaon ko shikshak banane ke liye Patna me ek vishesh sanstha banayi gayi, jise Badshah Nawab Razvi Training College kaha gaya. Yah January 1909 me Patna City ke Saiyid Badshah Nawab Razvi ke daan ki sahayta se shuru hui, jisse karib Rs 7,267 saalana ki aay hoti thi; yah Gulzarbagh ke paas sthit us bhavan me chalayi gayi, jo pehle Bettiah rajya ka tha tatha baad me sarkar ne kharid kar sudhara. Shuru me kam yogyata wali mahilaon ko prashikshan dene ke prayas kiye gaye, lekin yah nishphal raha; isliye ab mahilaon ko prashikshan se pehle middle star tak padhaya jaata tha. Pichhle chaar saal me is taiyari ke kaam me karib bees se adhik mahilayein lagi rahin tatha pichhle saal solah mahilayein taiyari se prashikshan kaksha me pahunchin. College me ek Lady Principal thi tatha sabhi staff tatha vidyarthiyon ke liye aavasiya vyavastha thi; iske saath ek lace class bhi judi hui thi. Exam point: Mahila prashikshan college January 1909 me Saiyid Badshah Nawab Razvi ke daan se shuru hua, jisse saalana karib Rs 7,267 ki aay hoti thi; yah Gulzarbagh ke paas Bettiah rajya ke purane bhavan me chala tatha iske saath ek lace class judi thi.

qe: Which madrasa, founded by Mr. Saiyid Nurul Huda and taken under Government management during the year 1919-20, had about 141 pupils and spacious new buildings under construction?
qh: किस मदरसे की स्थापना श्री सैयद नुरुल हुदा ने की तथा 1919-20 में उसे सरकारी प्रबंधन में ले लिया गया, जिसमें करीब 141 विद्यार्थी थे तथा नए विशाल भवन बन रहे थे?
e: Madrasa ek aisi sanstha hoti hai, jahan Arabi tatha Islami vidyaon ki shiksha di jaati hai. Patna me Madrasa Islamia Shamsul Huda naam ka madrasa Mr. Saiyid Nurul Huda ne shuru kiya tha tatha 1919-20 ke dauran ise sarkari prabandhan me le liya gaya. Sarvekshan ke samay yah sanstha abhi shuruawati avastha me thi, lekin iske liye vishal naye bhavan ban rahe the tatha aasha thi ki aage chalkar yah Islami vidya ka ek mahatvapurna kendra banega; us samay isme 141 vidyarthi padhte the. Isi prakar unnisvin shatabdi ke ant tatha beesvin shatabdi ke aarambh me Patna me madrase, Sanskrit tols tatha vyavsayik vidyalayaon jaisi vishesh sansthaon ka bhi vistar hua. Exam point: Madrasa Islamia Shamsul Huda ki sthapna Saiyid Nurul Huda ne ki, ise 1919-20 me sarkari prabandhan me liya gaya; us samay isme 141 vidyarthi the tatha iske liye naye vishal bhavan ban rahe the.

qe: The Oriental Public Library was founded in 1890 by Khan Bahadur Khuda Bakhsh Khan and contains a unique collection of manuscripts and books of which two languages?
qh: ओरिएंटल पब्लिक लाइब्रेरी की स्थापना 1890 में खान बहादुर खुदा बख़्श खान ने की थी तथा इसमें किन दो भाषाओं की पांडुलिपियों तथा पुस्तकों का अनोखा संग्रह है?
e: Patna me granth tatha sahitya ki parampara ko aage badhane wali kuch mahatvapurna sansthayein thi. Oriental Public Library ki sthapna 1890 me Khan Bahadur Khuda Bakhsh Khan ne ki thi tatha yah us bhavan me sthit hai, jise svayan sansthapak ne banwaya; isme Farsi tatha Arabi hastalikhit granthon ka anokha sangrah hai, jiska poora soochi-patr sarkari kharch par kai varsh se taiyar kiya ja raha tha. Iske saath hi Mr. Sachchidananda Sinha, jo Governor's Council ke sadasya the, ne apni svargiya patni ki smriti me Srimati Radhika Institute sthapit ki, jo Patna-Gaya Road ke paas ek naye bhavan me sthit tha tatha usme ek Public Library bhi thi. Bihar Young Men's Institute ka uddeshya Bankipore ke vibhinn colleges ke vidyarthiyon ke liye samajik suvidhaon ka prabandh karna tha. Exam point: Oriental Public Library 1890 me Khan Bahadur Khuda Bakhsh Khan ne sthapit ki tatha isme Farsi tatha Arabi pandulipiyon ka anokha sangrah hai; Sachchidananda Sinha ne apni patni ki smriti me Srimati Radhika Institute banayi.

qe: The Muhammadans formed 10 per cent of the population of the Patna district; what proportion of all the pupils under instruction did the Muhammadan pupils form, being 7,493 out of 51,489?
qh: पटना जिले की आबादी में मुसलमान 10 प्रतिशत थे; सभी शिक्षित विद्यार्थियों में मुसलमान विद्यार्थियों का हिस्सा कितना था, जो 51,489 में से 7,493 थे?
e: Shiksha ke kshetra me vibhinn samudayon ki bhaagidari ka aankalan bhi kiya gaya. Patna jile ki Muhammadan aabadi 1,574,287 me se 158,438 thi, yaani kul aabadi ka lagbhag das pratishat; iske vipreet Muhammadan vidyarthiyon ki sankhya 51,489 me se 7,493 thi, yaani kul vidyarthiyon ka lagbhag pandrah pratishat. Isse spasht tha ki Muhammadan aam ausat se peeche nahi the. Unki shiksha ki nigrani ke liye vibhag me ek special Inspecting Officer tatha ek Assistant Inspectress thi tatha jile me do inspecting maulavi bhi the; iske alava jile me ek Inspector of Schools, ek District Inspector tatha pandrah sub-inspectors bhi the. Exam point: jile ki Muhammadan aabadi das pratishat thi, jabki Muhammadan vidyarthi kul vidyarthiyon ka lagbhag pandrah pratishat the, 51,489 me se 7,493; unki shiksha ki nigrani ke liye special Inspecting Officer tatha Assistant Inspectress bhi the.

qe: At the time of the survey Patna, capital of Bihar and Orissa, had a population of 119,976; what was its population at the census of 1881, after which it steadily declined?
qh: सर्वेक्षण के समय बिहार तथा उड़ीसा की राजधानी पटना की आबादी 119,976 थी; 1881 की जनगणना में इसकी आबादी कितनी थी, जिसके बाद यह लगातार घटती रही?
e: Patna, jo Bihar tatha Orissa ki rajdhani tatha Patna jile ka mukhyalay nagar tha, Ganga ke dakshin tat par sthit hai. Sarvekshan ke samay yahan ki aabadi 119,976 thi, jisme 90,248 Hindu tatha 28,200 Muhammadan the. Dr. Buchanan ne 1812 me iski aabadi 312,000 anumanit ki thi, lekin William Tayler ka 1857 ka aankda 400,000 bahut badhaya-chadhaya mana gaya. 1881 ki janaganna me aabadi 170,654 thi, jiske baad se yah nirantar ghatati rahi; 1911 me yah 136,153 ho gayi thi. Aabadi ghatne ke karan me nagar ke vyapar tatha bade paimane ke udyog ka hras shamil tha. Exam point: Patna ki aabadi 1881 ki janaganna me 170,654 thi tatha uske baad yah nirantar ghatati rahi; 1911 me yah 136,153 tatha sarvekshan ke samay 119,976 thi, jisme 90,248 Hindu tatha 28,200 Muhammadan the.

qe: Among the causes that led to the decline of the commercial importance of Patna, apart from the change in means of communication, which two trades were abandoned?
qh: संचार के साधनों में बदलाव के अतिरिक्त, पटना के व्यापारिक महत्व के ह्रास के कारणों में किन दो व्यापारों को छोड़ दिया जाना शामिल था?
oe: The salt trade and the indigo trade
The timber trade and the coal trade
The sugar trade and the cloth trade
The Company's trade in the early nineteenth century and the opium trade in later years
oh: नमक का व्यापार तथा नील का व्यापार
लकड़ी का व्यापार तथा कोयले का व्यापार
चीनी का व्यापार तथा कपड़े का व्यापार
उन्नीसवीं सदी के आरंभ में कंपनी का व्यापार तथा बाद के वर्षों में अफ़ीम का व्यापार
e: Patna unnisvin shatabdi ke aarambh me upper India tatha Bangal ke beech vyapar ka bada kendra tha, lekin East Indian Railway ke aane ke baad nadi-marg ke vyapar ke patan se nagar par bura asar pada. Yah pravritti isliye aur badhi ki aas-paas ke jilon me railway sanchar sudhara - trans-Gangetic jilon me Tirhut State Railway ka vistar, Kiul se Gaya tak South Bihar Railway ka khulna, Patna-Gaya Line tatha Grand Chord Line. In local lines ke khulne par local upaj ko Patna bhej kar baantna laabhdayak nahi raha, kyunki chhoti doori ke booking rate kam nahi the; isliye beopari seedhe antim gantavya tak booking karne lage. In sab ke atirikt unnisvin shatabdi ke aarambh me Company ke vyapar ka parityag tatha baad ke varshon me Patna me sadiyon se chal rahe afim ke vyapar ka parityag bhi nagar ke patan ka karan bana; beesvin shatabdi ke aarambh me plague ne bhi nagar ko bura prabhavit kiya. Exam point: Patna ke vyapar-patan ke karanon me East Indian Railway tatha local railway lines ka vistar, unnisvin shatabdi ke aarambh me Company ke vyapar ka parityag tatha baad ke varshon me afim ke vyapar ka parityag shamil the.

qe: Each of the elementary training schools, designed to train vernacular teachers for primary schools, could hold how many teachers, the course being one year for students with middle qualifications and two years for others?
qh: प्राथमिक विद्यालयों के लिए देशी-भाषा के शिक्षक तैयार करने वाले प्रत्येक प्रारंभिक प्रशिक्षण विद्यालय में कितने शिक्षक रखे जा सकते थे, जहाँ middle योग्यता वालों के लिए कोर्स एक वर्ष तथा अन्य के लिए दो वर्ष का था?
e: Shikshakon ke prashikshan ki vyavastha me Patna me ek first-grade training school tatha aath elementary training schools shamil the. First-grade training school me pehle middle yogyata wale vidyarthiyon ke liye teen saal ka course chalta tha, lekin yah vyavastha badal kar ab matriculates ke liye do saal ka course kar diya gaya, tatha aise vidyarthi na milne par matriculation me fail hue vidyarthi liye jaate the; vidyarthiyon ko prashikshan ke dauran stipend milta tha tatha safal hone par unhe secondary schools me vernacular teacher ki naukri milti thi. Elementary training schools ka uddeshya primary schools ke liye vernacular teachers taiyar karna tha; har school me satrah teachers rakhe ja sakte the, jahan middle yogyata wale vidyarthiyon ke liye course ek saal tatha anya ke liye do saal ka tha. Sabhi training schools me vidyarthiyon ke liye hostel ki vyavastha thi. Exam point: elementary training school me satrah teachers tak rakhe ja sakte the tatha middle yogyata wale vidyarthiyon ke liye course ek saal ka tha; first-grade training school me matriculates ke liye do saal ka course tha, jahan vidyarthiyon ko stipend milta tha.

qe: In the mufassal most of the teachers in girls' schools were men, but in Patna itself how many women teachers called atus were working among the Muhammadans, their work supervised by a Lady Superintendent?
qh: मुफ़स्सल में बालिका विद्यालयों के अधिकांश शिक्षक पुरुष थे, लेकिन स्वयं पटना में मुसलमानों के बीच काम करने वाली 'अतु' कहलाने वाली कितनी महिला शिक्षिकाएँ थीं, जिनके काम की देखरेख एक लेडी सुपरिंटेंडेंट करती थीं?
e: Balika vidyalayaon ke samne ek vishesh kathinai yah thi ki unhe yogy mahila shikshak milna mushkil tha; mufassal yaani jile ke andaruni bhaag me adhiktar shikshak purush the, lekin Patna nagar me hi Muhammadan samuday ki ladkiyon ko padhane wali atharah mahila shikshikayein thin, jine atu kaha jaata tha tatha jinke kaam ki nigrani ke liye ek Lady Superintendent niyukt ki gayi thi. Balikaon ke liye vishesh sansthaon me Badshah Nawab Razvi Training College tatha uske saath judi lace class tatha Bankipore me Baptist Mission dwara chalayi jaane wali ek training class shamil thi. Patna me balika shiksha ka vistar 1880-81 ke baad tezi se hua, jab 1890-91 me assi balika vidyalaya ho gaye the. Exam point: Patna nagar me Muhammadan ladkiyon ko padhane wali atharah mahila shikshikayein thin, jine atu kaha jaata tha tatha unke kaam ki nigrani ek Lady Superintendent karti thi; mufassal me adhiktar shikshak purush the.

qe: The Bankipore (sadr) subdivision of Patna district, contained by the thanas of Phulwari and Masaurhi, had an area of 290 square miles and a population of how many?
qh: पटना जिले का बांकीपुर (सदर) अनुमंडल, जो फुलवारी तथा मसौढ़ी थानों में समाहित है, का क्षेत्रफल 290 वर्ग मील तथा जनसंख्या कितनी थी?
e: Patna jile ke Bankipore sadr subdivision ka kshetrafal do sau navve varg meel hai tatha iski janasankhya do lakh das hazaar saat sau bees thi. Is subdivision me do thane - Phulwari tatha Masaurhi - shamil hain. Alag-alag subdivisions ki aabaadi chhote-bade kshetrafal ke saath dekhi jaati hai, isliye do subdivisions ko tulna karne ke liye saade aankde yaad rakhna upyogi hota hai - Bankipore sadr subdivision ki janasankhya 210,720, Barh subdivision ki 354,833 tatha Bihar subdivision ki 569,635 thi. Aabaadi ka ghanatv yaani prati varg meel kitne log rehte hain, yah jaanne ke liye janasankhya tatha kshetrafal dono ki jarurat padti hai; Bankipore sadr subdivision kshetrafal me chhota hone par bhi abaadi ka ghantav tatha shahri suvidhaon ke karan alag pehchan rakhta hai. Exam point: Bankipore sadr subdivision ka kshetrafal 290 varg meel tatha janasankhya 210,720 thi; isme Phulwari tatha Masaurhi thane shamil the tatha yah Patna jile ka mukhya sadr kshetra tha.
